notes: Notifier consumes the unchanged offer.queued event, so it has no deployment dependency on customer and can roll independently. The new offer_caps table is additive and shared across instances; old sent rows are counted when enforcing the cap. During a mixed notifier rollout, old instances remain event-compatible but can still send without the new cap, so the cap is authoritative once all notifier instances are on the new version. Roll back only after considering that old code will ignore offer_caps.
